prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: production game walk-cycle sprite sheet. Create ONE square PNG sprite sheet, 4 equal columns by 4 equal rows, EXACTLY 16 separated full-body frames, preferably 1536x1536 pixels. TRUE transparent alpha background, no checkerboard, no scenery, no shadows, no labels, no letters or grid lines. Each cell must contain only ONE complete character centered horizontally with consistent scale and a fixed paw-ground baseline at 88% of cell height, at least 10% clear margins from ALL cell edges. Adjacent frames never touch. The SAME character in every cell. Four-legged walking, NOT bipedal. Fixed slightly elevated game camera, clean silhouettes readable when small. Row 1 (top): facing DOWN, walking TOWARD the viewer, front view. Row 2: facing LEFT, walking toward the left edge, side profile. Row 3: facing RIGHT, walking toward the right edge, side profile. Row 4 (bottom): facing UP, walking AWAY from viewer, full REAR VIEW showing back of head, back, hind legs and tail; absolutely NO face or eyes visible in the rear row. Within each row the 4 columns are four different looping gait phases: left-front/right-hind contact, passing feet, right-front/left-hind contact, opposite passing feet. Clearly alternate lifted paws and planted paws across columns. Same body/head size within a row, change legs and slight tail sway, no stretching or changing identity. Preserve reference palette, markings, ear shapes, eyes, proportions and illustration style; clean alpha edges.
Reference image is MARO only: a very round cream-colored Scottish Fold cat with small folded ears, large round golden-brown eyes, pale tan forehead and body markings, fluffy thick tail, gentle expression. Preserve this exact recognizable cat and delicate warm watercolor shading. The reference is sitting; show him standing and WALKING on all four short paws, keeping his plump rounded silhouette. No collar, no clothing, no accessories. The front row must retain his recognizable big round face.
